# Restarting the server mid-game continues the game (M1 done-when 4).
start official first=away
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
sensor away_goal
expect score 1:2
plus away
undo
restart
expect phase playing
expect score 1:2
expect next_ball home
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
expect score 1:5
expect winner away
expect games 1

# After a finished game the server comes back idle.
restart
expect phase idle

# A new game keeps counting from its own events.
start official
sensor away_goal
restart
restart
expect score 1:0
sensor away_goal
expect score 2:0
expect games 2
